items.title: Invesco (IVZ) Stock Sees Fair Value Lift After Analysts Raise Targets
items.summary: Invesco’s updated fair value estimate has shifted from about US$29.96 to roughly US$32.79, which points to a higher price target in the latest round of research work. Analysts linking this change to recent Q2 flows, operating leverage potential, and the role of products such as QQQ are keeping ratings mostly steady but are adjusting where they think the stock now fits. items.title: How a Few Hot Stocks Can Make ‘Twin’ Funds Act Like Strangers
items.summary: The stock market’s identical twins are looking like opposites.  Just look at exchange-traded funds that invest in large, fast-growing U.S. companies.  The iShares Russell 1000 Growth ETF is up 4.6%, while Invesco S&P 500 Pure Growth has gained 24.3%.
